correctness.rationale: The concept domain is path vertices and hypotheses are all inclusion-minimal dominating sets, not only minimum-cardinality sets. Reconstructed the private-neighbor criterion, independently enumerated all masks and computed VC dimension through all shattering trace projections and Littlestone dimension by exact adaptive-split recurrence for n=1..11. Values for n=1..10 coincide, and n=11 has exactly 36 hypotheses, VCdim=4, Ldim=5. Independently decoded the actual attached certificates.json blob da3a9118dd7a49cfa5a26c3076b26f04920deb91: all 16 labels on zero-based {0,2,7,9} have valid minimal-dominator witnesses, and all 31 query nodes and 32 distinct leaves of the depth-five decision tree satisfy their path labels and minimal domination; checks returned no errors. All 462 possible 5-query subsets fail shattering, while 36<64 excludes depth six. For disjoint copies of P11, minimal dominating concept class is a product; VCdim and Ldim add on disjoint domains by trace/product and the standard minimax split induction, hence VC=4s,Ldim=5s for all positive s. Finite enumeration is exact for its bounded cases; the product lemma supplies the infinite extension.

value.rationale: PASS because inclusion-minimal dominating sets are a canonical combinatorial solution class, and static versus adaptive membership shattering are mathematically distinct learning dimensions. The smallest separating path P11 is a well-motivated exact finite cutoff, not an arbitrary slice, and the disjoint-union product yields an unbounded linear separation inside forests of degree at most two. The result does not need a general formula for larger connected paths to be useful.
